steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to the sample as directed.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a DNeasy Mini spin column (Qiagen, Hilden, DE) and centrifuge at 8,000 rpm.

steps.title: Incubate with elution buffer
steps.instruction: Incubate the DNA‑bound membrane with elution Buffer AE for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 minute to elute the DNA.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Darmstadt, DE).
